task: T3 of the owner-approved autonomous plan: river runoff AMOUNT
status: declared before any score of any variant below
why: rotclimate/routing.py runoff_from_months (annual runoff: monthly P - min(P, 0.75 x Hargreaves-like PET)) feeds absolute discharge Q for delta fans (harvest/deltas.py; data/delta_fan_model.json was fitted on OBSERVED HydroRIVERS Q, area ~ Q^1.06) and simulated rivers (R.segments). The seasonal runoff test (calibration/runoff_20261120) found the amount ~0.4 of observed for polity/seasons.py; this rule was never tested.
target: GRUN v1 1970-2000 annual runoff (data/cache/grun, as calibration/runoff_20261120)
model_input: WorldClim 2.1 monthly tavg and prec (the rule's only inputs), Earth window 0-56 N, 12 W-125 E, runoff averaged to 0.5 deg over land (>= 50 % land)

variants.budyko_fu: annual Fu (1981) curve on the rule's annual PET: E = P (1 + PET/P - (1 + (PET/P)^w)^(1/w)), w in {1.5, 2.0, 2.6, 3.5}

domain: 0.5-deg cells valid in both grids with GRUN annual >= 5 mm
split: NEW 10-degree checkerboard offset by 5 deg from calibration/runoff_20261120 ((floor((lat+5)/10) + floor((lon+5)/10)) mod 2): dev 0, blind 1. Disclosure: the earlier test reported the blind annual ratio for a different runoff rule (polity/seasons.py) on the old split; no score of this rule was ever computed.

scores.primary: RMSE of ln((model + 10) / (GRUN + 10)) over cells (annual mm)
scores.rank: Spearman of annual runoff over cells

choice: variant with the lowest dev primary

blind_gates.G1: chosen blind primary <= 0.85 x current blind primary
blind_gates.G2: chosen blind rank >= current blind rank - 0.02
blind_gates.adopt: all three: routing.runoff_from_months uses the chosen rule (the climate model's own physics untouched). Deltas and simulated rivers change at the next full atlas rebuild (deltas feed the harvest cascade), bundled with any later adoption from T4-T6 or the next climate. Otherwise the current rule stays and the bias is reported.
